messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 5xxs detected for /v1/generate (api-gateway) in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. 5xx rate ~8.7% over last 5m. auto-paging oncall. dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/INC-1718459999
pagerduty-bot: Paging alice (oncall)
alice: ack — i'm on. pulling graphs and customer tickets now. any quick notes on scope?
emily: Support here: seeing multiple customer errors (502/504) starting ~11:26 UTC. examples: TICKET-5521, TICKET-5524. customers see immediate failures for generation calls.
bob: checking envoy upstreams — cluster "model-infer-us" spiking 502/504. envoy stats snapshot (rolling 5m):
``ncluster.model-infer-us.upstream_rq_5xx: 378
cluster.model-infer-us.upstream_rq_504: 245
cluster.model-infer-us.upstream_rq_502: 91
cluster.model-infer-us.upstream_cx_connect_fail: 29
```
clara: we deployed gateway-config rev 2024-02-19T11:22 (small route tweak). i remember a change that added retry handling to the /v1/generate virtual host.
dan: grabbing the rollout diff now. here's the route fragment that went live at 11:21:
``n- name: /v1/generate
  route: cluster_model_infer_us
  # previously no retry config
+ retry_policy:
+   retry_on: "5xx,connect,reset"
+   num_retries: 3
+   per_try_timeout: 40ms
```
bob: that per_try_timeout + retries smells like amplification. if upstream briefly exceeds 40ms, we spin retries at the gateway and double/triple the load. explains the connect resets and downstream 504s.
alice: mitigation plan: remove retry_policy on /v1/generate immediately (minimal change), and revert routing tweak in a follow-up. who can patch and roll asap? want minimal blast radius.
dan: i can patch configmap and roll the edge-gateway pods. applying now: 
``nkubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/data/routes/v1_generate/retry_policy"}]'
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/edge-gateway
```
ops-bot: Deploy started: edge-gateway rollout triggered by dan at 2024-02-19T11:33:10Z
bob: running internal canary against gateway during rollout. before patch:
``n$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://internal-gateway/v1/generate
502
```
...waiting for rollout... after rollout:
``n$ curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://internal-gateway/v1/generate
200
```
bob: metrics are coming down — 5xx back to baseline (~0.6%). upstream_cx_connect_fail rate declining. logs show fewer reset/connect failures.
emily: i'll update affected customers: tell them we've applied a mitigation (removed gateway retries) and to retry. i'll keep tickets open until they confirm. any temporary client-side workaround?
alice: No client workaround needed; ask them to retry and we will escalate if they still see failures.
clara: follow-ups noted: the PR that added retries didn't have a load-safety check. we should add config validation to block per_try_timeout < 100ms for high-throughput routes, and require canary rollout for retry policy changes. adding to postmortem.
dan: opened PR to add a lint rule in infra-config: enforce min per_try_timeout and max retries for routes marked high-throughput. also scheduled a canary job to exercise /v1/generate on config changes.
alice: incident mitigated. duration ~11:26–11:36 (≈10m). impact: elevated 5xx and timeouts for /v1/generate across two regions; multiple customer reports. root cause: aggressive retry_policy rollout (num_retries=3, per_try_timeout=40ms) causing retry amplification and upstream overload.
alice: handing monitoring to claire for the next 4h — claire can you take it? please watch dashboards and customer tickets, escalate back if we see resurgence.
claire: oncall ack. will monitor and ping if anything spikes.
pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged by alice. continued monitoring owner: claire.
incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated; mitigation=removed gateway retry_policy; followup=postmortem assigned to eng-reliability; tags=[envoy,gateway,retries,5xx,amplification]
alice: follow-ups: 1) postmortem w/ timeline + config diff; 2) infra-config CI check for per_try_timeout & retries; 3) require canary runs for retry policy changes; owners assigned in IMP-1718459999.
emily: i'll notify customers once they confirm success and then close tickets.
alice: :white_check_mark: closing active mitigation channel. keep monitoring for 30m then we'll do a short retro. thanks everyone.
